report:
Freshly reviewed the generated_identity claim, all four ordinary implementation associations, both ordinary tests and the explicit TODO entry. Captured fixture/root setup, the builtin-derive test provider, origin-span dispatch and builtin output generation as supporting dependencies. No production changes.

ParseSource in span.rs identifies bang output by selected MacroDefSymbol plus LocalMacroInvocationSym, and derive output by DeriveExpansion, rather than by generated text or source coordinates. LocalMacroInvocationSym keeps CST/input tokens and absolute span as tracked details; its tracked parse_output operation combines invocation identity and macro definition into the output source and parses current output text. derive.rs interns derive name, stable source item, attribute index, derive-list index and selected macro definition. Its origin method reads the source item's current absolute span; builtin_derive_output recomputes generated text from current item syntax behind a tracked query. Neither origin coordinates nor generated text are interned identity fields. parse_output is a tracked boundary retaining generated symbol identity across repeated demands.

mods.rs enumerates both attribute and derive-list occurrence indexes and passes them to expand_derive, so equal derive names in distinct positions do not collapse. The resolved macro definition is included in that identity. The current mods.rs visibility/association change to symbol_local_item leaves all occurrence construction and derive expansion behavior unchanged. Captured builtin generation reads current fields from the source item's CST; captured absolute_span dispatch supplies current tracked spans rather than a frozen copy in the derive identity.

The duplicate_derive_occurrences_have_distinct_generated_source_identity test parses one item with Clone listed twice, collects actual generated impl parse-source handles, requires exactly two, requires unequal identities and verifies indexes 0 and 1. moving_source_item_preserves_derive_expansion_identity uses a persistent database, inserts a newline before the source item, reparses/re-expands, and explicitly requires equal expansion IDs with different origin offsets. The captured test provider supplies a recognized builtin Clone definition; fixture helpers parse actual source into the crate. These tests establish derive occurrence separation and coordinate updates without reminting, rather than merely comparing rendered names.

The associated types_spans_generated_identity TODO explicitly retains nested expansion identity/text/origin/coordinate comparisons. Existing tests do not establish the entire bang/nested expansion edit matrix or generated-text change behavior; those remain visibly deferred and require persistent nested fixtures comparing identities and mutable facts independently. No N/A entries apply.

Executed cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib generated_source_identity and cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib moving_source_item_preserves_derive_expansion_identity: one associated test passed in each command, zero failures. All implementation/test entries and claim qualifications are accounted for by source structure, concrete derive assertions and explicit remaining verification TODO. No edits requested.
